item.title: PortWin 1.21
item.description:
• Windows of Windows programs now come to the front after launch — Stage Manager no longer hides them (this is what made the Steam sign-in window "disappear")
  • Built-in engine now uses DXMT 0.74: Skyrim Special Edition and other DirectX 11 games that crashed while loading a world work again
  • Known games get ready-made fixes: PortWin spots an installed game (starting with Skyrim SE) and offers to apply them in one click
  • Per-program settings: each program can have its own graphics engine, Windows version and launch arguments (right-click → Program Settings…)
  • Bottle backups: instant snapshots you can restore in one click; made automatically before Fix Automatically and before changing graphics
  • System Check now draws a real Direct3D 11 frame on every engine
  • "AVX for games" option (on by default), log files capped at 40 MB, a clear prompt when changing graphics while programs are running
  • Steam recipe: sign in with account name and password; Licenses & Acknowledgements window
